```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
```

Read in data
```{r}
HBR_StrChem <- read.csv(here("Data","HBR_StrChem_1963-2025.csv")) %>%
  mutate(date = as.Date(date))
glimpse(HBR_StrChem)
```

Summarize
```{r}
HBR_StrChem_summary <- HBR_StrChem %>%
  select(site, date, NO3, NH4, TDN, DON) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(NO3, NH4, TDN, DON), names_to = "analyte", values_to = "value") %>%
  filter_out(is.na(value)) %>%
  group_by(site, analyte) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), start = min(date), end = max(date))
```
